name: c
notes: Root language of the software domain: the preprocessor-free ILP32 integer-C fragment SV-COMP's ReachSafety loop/bitvector tasks are written in — all integer widths through long long, one- and two-dimensional static arrays, goto, non-recursive helper functions (inlined), __VERIFIER_nondet_* as frame-addressed inputs, reach_error via __assert_fail as the bad observable; no pointers, floats, heap, structs, or recursion. Semantics is total and deterministic, chosen to be exactly mirrorable by a bit-vector transition system: two's-complement wrap everywhere, SMT-LIB division-by-zero rules (matching btor2), saturating out-of-range shifts, out-of-range array reads 0 / writes dropped. Execution is a machine over an elaborated CFG — each asgn/havoc/br node is one frame, exactly btor2's stimulus discipline ({"steps": [...]}, s_0 checked first, absorbing HALT/ERR) — so the c--btor2 pair keeps bad AND depth exactly. Validated beyond the vectors by differential testing against clang -O0 -fwrapv on the in-fragment SV-COMP corpus (random recorded-tape stimuli; see runs provenance) — 594 of the 598 in-fragment tasks interpret cleanly, the other 4 are dynamic VLAs refused loudly. Graded stipulated until corroborated by benchmark labels (the domain's anchors). Era-6 revision 1 = the Era-5 c text re-cut and re-admitted; the differential runs against clang are oracle testimony recorded as domain anchors (KERNEL.md §6). Revision 3 replaces the `induction` judge by one independent of the C-to-BTOR2 road: the machine is built by the RISC-V road — the c front end, a branch-before-fence variant of the c--riscv generator, the riscv assembler and the riscv--btor2 instruction semantics, closed with pc over C nodes (codes: node index, HALT = L, ERR = L + 1) and memory registerized word by word (arrays refused) — and judged by the btor2 judges' obligations; the same payloads (k-induction, bit-invariant, clause-invariant over pc and slot atoms) discharge with the same obligations as revision 2 on every vector, and the language's lineage now names the RISC-V road and not c2btor2-g1, so a proof that travelled the C-to-BTOR2 pair is certified by an encoding that pair never touched. Two new vectors carry a 34-clause invariant over slot and pc bits; their mutants flip a slot bit and drop the guard clause.
